calderon.description: Calderon et al. 2019 — Human immune ATAC-seq across 19 cell types

summaries.title: ATAC-seq data
summaries.summary: The immune system depends on a balanced interplay among a variety of specialized cell types transitioning between resting and stimulated states. While epigenome mapping efforts have focused on resting ex vivo immune cells, efforts to characterize stimulation-induced chromatin changes of diverse cell types has been limited. Thus, we collected ATAC-seq and RNA-seq data from immune cell types under resting and stimulated conditions from blood of healthy individuals, and cell types from fetal thymus
summaries.gdstype: Genome binding/occupancy profiling by high throughput sequencing
